# Third-party dependencies

Do not paste or commit third-party SDKs here unless their license permits redistribution and the license/provenance record is complete.

Permissive source can be added as a pinned dependency or submodule after review. Proprietary binaries remain local and gitignored.

Full, commit-pinned upstream source archives used only for architecture study are
under `reference-repositories/`. They are not dependencies and must not be copied
into product code without a fresh license, security and suitability review.
